title: Customer due diligence and risk-based procedures
definition: The requirement to establish and verify a customer's identity, to understand the nature and purpose of the relationship, to develop a risk profile, and to apply enhanced procedures where the profile warrants them. The obligation is risk-based: the depth of the procedures follows the risk, and the institution is expected to revisit the profile when circumstances change rather than at a fixed interval. This record summarises the requirement.
evidence_to_cite: the customer due diligence file and the date each element was collected
the risk rating assigned and the basis for it
the enhanced procedures applied, and the trigger that required them

sources.citation: Customer due diligence requirements for banks (31 CFR 1020.210 and 1020.220) and the customer due diligence rule (31 CFR 1010.230), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
